Local alteration: fixed() uses per-call stack-local Huffman tables instead of
mutable permanent static arrays and first-call initialization. Decode logic
and license notice remain unchanged. fixed/dynamic table builders are marked
noinline on GCC/Clang so their mutually exclusive arrays keep separate bounded
stack frames on ESP32-C3. Both alterations are explicitly marked in puff.c.
License: full upstream notice in puff.h and assets/licenses/PUFF-LICENSE.txt.
